set.name: Select File
set.description: Picks any file (PDF, ZIP, Office…) through the WordPress media modal (wp.media), limited to the allowed file types. Empty shows a dashed file tile and “Select file”; Filled shows the chosen file with Replace and Remove. Per-locale text props; buttons are exposed instances.
